name: Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor

timeline.event: Breakthrough in the Keshkal ghat tunnel, Chhattisgarh's first highway tunnel
Several sections in final stages; opening expected in phases

history: This new expressway is being built to give Chhattisgarh and southern Odisha a fast, direct road to Visakhapatnam and its big sea port. The current route between Raipur and Visakhapatnam winds for nearly 590 km, while the new corridor is a much straighter 464 km, expected to roughly halve the travel time. It runs through the hills and forests of the Bastar region and the Eastern Ghats, and includes a twin tunnel through the Keshkal ghat — the first highway tunnel in Chhattisgarh. As of mid-2026 it is still under construction, with opening expected in phases.
facts: Designated NH 130CD, one of the Bharatmala economic corridors.
Shortens the Raipur–Visakhapatnam road trip from about 590 km to about 464 km.
Expected to roughly halve the travel time, to around 7 hours.
Includes a 2.79 km twin-tube tunnel at Keshkal ghat — Chhattisgarh's first highway tunnel.
Gives central India's mining and farming belt a faster link to Visakhapatnam port.

sources.title: NHAI — National Highways Authority of India
